title: Min Max Game
summary: Given an integer array nums whose length is a power of 2, repeatedly create a new array by replacing each element with either the minimum or maximum of two consecutive elements from the original array, depending on the element's index.
statement: Given an integer array nums whose length is a power of 2, repeatedly create a new array by replacing each element with either the minimum or maximum of two consecutive elements from the original array, depending on the element's index. Continue this process until only one element remains, which is then returned.
constraints: The nonempty array length is a power of two.
In each round, output index i uses min of input positions 2i and 2i+1 when i is even, otherwise max.
Repeat on the new half-length array until one value remains.
hints: Simulate each round because every output depends only on one disjoint input pair.
Build a half-length list, alternating min and max according to the new index parity.
Replace values with that list until its length is one.
Each round exactly matches the defined pair transformation, and power-of-two length guarantees repeated halving reaches one.
editorial: Each round exactly matches the defined pair transformation, and power-of-two length guarantees repeated halving reaches one.

tests.explanation: A one-element array is already the final game result.
